purpose: Compare three separate lightweight navigation policies trained with a StreamVLN-style recipe, then frozen for the separately specified world-model and scorer experiments.
checkpoint_revision_source: Official Hugging Face model API metadata inspected on 2026-10-23.

shared_plan.initialization: Use each model's pretrained VLM weights; do not load the original StreamVLN navigation weights into a different backbone.
navigation_training: DAgger using each trial policy and simulator expert labels
shared_plan.streaming_integration: Adapt observation/action formatting, bounded dialogue context, visual history, and inference cache handling for each backbone.
shared_plan.initial_efficiency_strategy: LoRA with a frozen policy visual encoder; exact adapter/projector settings, precision, and window budgets remain open pending profiling.
shared_plan.world_model: Four separate world-model trial families are specified in World_Model_Trials.json; this file locks navigation backbones only.
shared_plan.scorer: Instruction/context features from the frozen trained policy, eight real-history memory slots, candidate action, and predicted next DINO patches; two attention blocks and utility/success/collision heads. See Scorer_Design.md and Scorer/config.json.
shared_plan.scorer_reference_status: Scorer and interface CPU checks implemented; saved native model metadata widths checked at 960/896/2048. Prefill hook primitive and runtime lifecycle implemented; actual trained policy wiring, CE runs and GPU profiling pending. See Architecture_Compatibility.md.
shared_plan.policy_adapter_contract: Use each native model family/processor. Capture final decoder norm during exactly one real-history prefill; use expanded attention masks and last valid token. Initially rebuild bounded real-history prompts after each actual action; cache reuse requires agreement with replay. The selected OneVision checkpoint is native LLaVA, not an automatically interchangeable HF class.
shared_plan.inference: Evaluate FORWARD, LEFT, RIGHT, and STOP with one-action predictions. STOP uses the current view. Override the base action only under a development-validated margin; execute once, observe reality, and update actual history.
comparison_controls: Same expert dataset and scene splits
Matched DAgger rollout and expert-query budgets; record policy-dependent visit distributions
Matched sensing, evaluation episodes, and candidate budgets
Fixed policy checkpoint within each with/without-world-model comparison
Hold world-model variant and scorer protocol fixed when comparing navigation backbones; compare world-model variants separately with a fixed policy and shared branch data
Record precision, history/token budgets, full pipeline latency, and peak memory

open_decisions: Training and inference memory profiles on the 8 GB target
Exact optimizer, LoRA targets/rank, projector training, precision, and history budgets
Backbone-specific real-context feature extraction, action-ID mapping, and cache updates
CE validation of scorer utility weights, memory capacity, and override margin
